model.subject: epilepsiae_1146
model.signal: Gaussian contact average of E-spike counts in 2-ms bins, Gaussian temporal sigma=5 ms; no voltage forward model.
model.TFR_input: Unfiltered frozen firing-density trace, NOT its 30-80 Hz plotting derivative.
model.existing_A_markers: Peaks of the 30-80 Hz derivative at 76/68/62 ms in the 4310-4430 ms crop; neither observer centroid nor TFR centroid.
model.spectrum_limit: Temporal smoothing and pulse shape dominate this low-frequency rate spectrum. It does not establish a model HFO oscillation.

patient.subject: epilepsiae_1146
patient.source_signal: Actual SEEG: CAR, 50/100/150/200/250-Hz notch, 80-250-Hz bandpass; frozen 250-ms band_tile.
patient.membership: Exact event ID in the 30049-event development target. Do not infer membership of the later 19770-event FIT split from this alone.
patient.selection: Reuse previously selected Fig2 TA exemplar; not selected here for closest model similarity.
patient.previous_cache_centroid: Peak enhancement connected-component centroid, threshold 0.70. Not reused as the new S^3 centroid.
patient.original_fitting_centroid: Legacy lagPatRaw S^3 time-frequency centroid on a stitched event timeline; stored seconds converted to milliseconds. Its rank is preserved.

fitting_marker_time_recovery.rule: Original producer selects inclusive sample endpoints, stitches packed tiles per 200-s segment. Sum preceding tile sample counts / 1024, subtract this from stored fitting centroid; then subtract 125 ms for centered display.
fitting_marker_time_recovery.legacy_code_boundary: The legacy source has a 500-ms default, but these actual packed artifacts are 250 ms. Window size is taken from artifacts, not the legacy default.

TFR.algorithm: magnitude STFT, Hamming 50 ms, 80% overlap, nfft=nperseg, constant detrend; Gaussian sigma=1.5 in frequency/time bins BEFORE crop; W=S^3.
TFR.normalization: Each channel/event magnitude divided by its own maximum; not power or cross-contact amplitude.
TFR.time_origin: Each 250-ms event window center; no channel-specific shifts, no event-specific time stretch.
TFR.relation_to_current_Fig1: Same full-window S^3 rule, but isolated 250-ms tiles rather than full stitched preprocessing segments; newly derived display, not exact legacy lagPatRaw replay.
TFR.marker_legend: Legend omitted on canvas per author. Amber circle: newly calculated full-tile S^3 TFR centroid. Black top tick: stored timing used for rank. Thin amber lines connect adjacent contacts only within the same shaft.

rank.display: Original fitting-readout rank among all 15 participating contacts, 1-based; all 15 contacts shown in SCL9–6 then ICL11–1 anatomical shaft order. Not reranked in this subset.

loss.scales: Frozen positive medians of squared embedding distances in patient CAL draws of 16 events; never re-estimated from this example.
loss.feature_map: Frozen multiscale random Fourier features; rank/participation additionally include linear features; timing includes within-ICL, within-SCL and intershaft delays.
loss.J_joint_role: Offline joint-feature diagnostic for xy_left_20, NOT its optimization loss. Later stages 13-16 jointly optimize J and J_joint.
loss.current_panel_mapping: F: optimization progress; G: actual loss profiles; H: position density; I: actual loss components and total J
loss.display_error_definition: Each error first averages absolute model-patient differences within SCL and ICL, then averages the two shafts equally. Rank: conditional participating normalized mean ranks; order: within-shaft co-participating pair precedence probabilities; participation: contact participation probabilities.
loss.statistical_unit: A full 60-s native trajectory (151 eligible events after 1500-ms burnin), not the one illustrated event; comparator is the frozen patient FIT event distribution.
loss.stages: 1-5 label-conditioned development; 6-12 label-free J; 13-16 J and J_joint multiobjective. No single sum of the three displayed errors is the universal optimization objective.
loss.caption_formula: L_g(x_hat_g,x_g) = D_off,g/s_g; Loss = J = (L_r + L_o + L_p)/3. Same component definitions and symbols in C/G/I.

aggregate.D_off_formula: (S_g dot S_g-Q_g)/(n*(n-1)) - 2*(S_g dot mu_patient,g)/n + mu_patient,g dot mu_patient,g
aggregate.S_g: Sum of event feature vectors phi_g(x_i)
aggregate.Q_g: Sum of squared norms of individual event feature vectors
aggregate.normalization: Ordered distinct event-occurrence pairs n*(n-1); n changes with resampled block event counts
aggregate.J_joint: Not evaluated for this historical scan

uncertainty.statistical_unit: A 4.5 s physical-time block of events within one 60 s simulated trajectory
uncertainty.duplicate_handling: Repeated blocks create repeated event occurrences; subtract Q with LINEAR multiplicities. Distinct copies remain in off-diagonal pairs, matching the original scorer on a materialized bootstrap sample.
uncertainty.covariance: Variance of jointly recomputed J, including covariance of its three calibrated components
uncertainty.limitations: Conditional finite-event uncertainty; no independent seed/network variance or patient uncertainty. Block exchangeability and finite temporal dependence are assumptions; block-size sensitivity retained.
uncertainty.shown_bands: Each actual training component and total J plus/minus its own 13-block-bootstrap SD; total uses the joint draws and includes component covariance.

optimum.claim: Empirical minimum within 13 tested angles; neither unique population optimum nor joint minimum of all components and variance.
optimum.marker: Vertical dashed line computed from original J argmin; no arrow or star

I.panel_C_F_integration: Same algebraic definition J=(1/3)sum D_off,g/s_g. Frozen maps/scales may differ across experiments: do not assert identical calibration without checking parent sources. C repeats optimizations; I resamples within one run.

historical_descriptive_errors.label: Error
historical_descriptive_errors.meaning: Original raw descriptive MAEs; preserved exactly; NOT literal additive summands of J.
historical_descriptive_errors.shade: Each raw error plus/minus its own conditional physical-time block bootstrap SD, same 13-block draw scheme.

shared_neuron_layout.coordinates: Original frozen overview coordinates; display subset only

DE.core_fill_meaning: Categorical purple fill inside E core only; complement unshaded
DE.display_window_rule: Fixed 1500-2900 ms window after burn-in; first three complete local bursts in E; identical D/E interval
DE.field_overlay: Shared spaced E/I schematic in B/D/E; D unchanged white background and dashed ROI; E purple core interior with white complement

metadata.statistical_unit: One 10 s native trajectory per condition on the same topology; E unchanged; not independent seed replication.
metadata.primary_D_identity: Zero core; all background thresholds and global weights; independent Poisson afferents to every E/I neuron at the previous silent-D mean; no local input patch or OU drive
metadata.diagnostic_D_identity: Threshold-ablation only, NOT no-core; identical input stream to E
metadata.input_mean_boundary: D: independent Poisson at nu throughout; E: unchanged local max(0.95*nu+OU,0) Poisson patch and deterministic exterior. D/E are different working regimes, not a one-factor causal test.
metadata.raster: All cells of the same fixed circular ROI, E then I, ascending original ID within type; no active-cell selection; E red and I blue.
metadata.lfp_definition: LFPRecorder spatially weighted mean of abs(I_E)+abs(I_I) over E near the fixed original core centre; unfiltered native current proxy, not measured extracellular voltage.
metadata.current_units: Voltage-equivalent model current (mV in LIF equation), not nA or extracellular mV.
metadata.EI_balance_definition: Separate mean excitatory/inhibitory magnitudes, ratio I_I/I_E, signed residual and mean per-cell abs(I_E-I_I)/(mean I_E + mean I_I); read-only 1 ms samples. No balance inference from sparsity.
metadata.event_definition: Non-overlapping 10 ms bins: >=1% distinct E cells globally or >=10% distinct E cells in fixed input patch; adjacent supra-threshold bins merged across <=100 ms gaps; report duration, do not equate with patient HFO.

global_E.boundary_rule: Events touching trajectory end are right-censored and excluded from complete burst counts; retain their observed interval as lower bound.
